features.feature: Share target: create board from shared content
features.note: built on parity/team-d-freeform; not yet verified on Midget. The manifest offers Freeform for pictures and plain text (handles, alternate rank) and the app puts shared text, web addresses and files on a new board ("Shared N"; the Input::Open and inbound document paths). A shared web address is only taken when another app sends it as text, because claiming the https scheme would compete with the browser for every link. A chosen existing board is not offered.
